answer_2.quote: For assessment of the synthesized speech, we conduct a detailed analysis using [...] We evaluate using Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER) for ASR, macro-F1 for SLID, and multiple metrics including Mel-Cepstral Distortion (MCD), Log F0 Root Mean Square Error (LogF0RMSE), SpeechTokenDistance, Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), UTMOS (a predicted Mean Opinion Score, MOS), and Speech-BERTScore for TTS.
